visual_description: A small, pen-sized hand tool. It has a thick, ergonomic teal-colored rubber handle designed for a palm-grip. The 'blade' is a very short, sharp needle-thin piece of stainless steel. It looks more like a surgical instrument than a construction tool.

constraints.anatomy: No striking cap; designed for hand-pressure only.
constraints.logic: Provides a sense of extreme precision and fragility.
